# laravel_cloud_edge_networks (Data Source)

Lists the edge networks available to the organization. An edge network is a CDN zone; it carries no IP addresses. For egress IP ranges, use the laravel_cloud_ip_addresses data source instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_edge_networks" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `edge_networks` (Attributes List) Available edge networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--edge_networks))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--edge_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `edge_networks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the edge network was created.
- `domain` (String) Domain served by this edge network.
- `id` (String) Edge network ID.
- `name` (String) Edge network name.
- `status` (String) Edge network status (requesting, creating, available, deleting, deleted, unknown).
- `tenancy_type` (String) Tenancy type (shared, dedicated).
